The '''Vantom''' is a {{2|Bosses|Boss}} found in the {{2|Overgrowth}}.

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Vantom}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Ink Blot
|Intent = Attack2
|Effect = Deals (7;{{Asc2|9|8}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Inky Lance
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (6;{{Asc2|9|7}}) damage ×2.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Dismember
|Intent = Attack4, StatusCard
|Effect = Deals (27;{{Asc2|9|30}}) damage. Shuffles 3 {{C2|Wound}} into your discard pile.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Prepare
|Intent = Buff
|Effect = Gains 2 {{BD2|Strength}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Strength
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
The Vantom cycles through its four moves in a fixed order, repeating forever:
# {{Int2|Vantom|Ink Blot}}
# {{Int2|Vantom|Inky Lance}}
# {{Int2|Vantom|Dismember}}
# {{Int2|Vantom|Prepare}}

== Useful Cards ==
* Multi-hit attacks like {{C2|Conflagration}} or {{C2|Lunar Blast}} are effective at removing {{BD2|Slippery}} stacks quickly.
* Even small amounts of {{BD2|Poison}} can consistently remove a stack of {{BD2|Slippery}} each turn. With {{C2|Accelerant}}, it will remove 2 (3 if {{KW2|Upgrade|Upgraded}}) stacks per turn, as long as Vantom has enough stacks of {{BD2|Poison}} for all instances to activate.
* Consistent damage over time from cards like {{C2|Inferno}} or relics like {{R2|Mercury Hourglass}} can help remove {{BD2|Slippery}} faster.
* Cards like {{C2|Stoke}} or {{C2|BEGONE!}} can remove {{C2|Wound}} from your deck.
